relay.description: Relay this app to many principals instead of an agent or operation: true, or {holdSeconds?, maxParts?, admit?, charge?, notices?}. Principals use the returned relayPath.

allow.description: Provider user IDs admitted to this binding; empty denies everyone unless open is true.

signingSecret.description: App signing secret reference; enables Events API callbacks at the returned webhookPath.

appToken.description: App-level token reference (connections:write); enables Socket Mode, which needs no public URL. Bindings holding the same token share one connection; use one token per app.

allowChannels.description: Channels allowed for mentions and explicit outbound sends. Sender admission alone does not authorize channel publication.

name: Create Slack binding
description: Create a durable caller-owned Slack binding. All credentials must be secret references; user is implicit. Requires slack/manage. signingSecret receives Events API callbacks at the returned webhookPath; appToken receives events over Socket Mode instead, without a public URL.
